When I write an image request with /commands (e.g. /8k /goldenhour /droneview /16:9 /clean /mj), expand each into rich prompt wording (8k = extreme detail, goldenhour = warm low sun, droneview = high aerial angle), put the subject first then camera, light, style, quality, drop the earlier of any conflicting pair, and generate the image. /16:9 /9:16 /square set the aspect ratio. /clean /nodeform /nopeople mean avoid text, bad hands, people. /mj /sd /flux /kling /flow /gemini /dalle format the prompt for that tool. Always show the final prompt.
